symptom: `mxcli run --local`: when a page action throws, the browser shows the generic Mendix error dialog and there is nothing to correlate it against — the runtime's own stdout/stderr (server stack trace, microflow `LOG` output) is swallowed, so a server-side bug can't be told apart from a client one
cause: The runtime JVM was spawned with `cmd.Stdout=log; cmd.Stderr=log` where `log` is an in-memory `syncBuffer` surfaced only on a *startup* failure; during normal operation it goes nowhere on disk
insight: Tee the JVM's stdout+stderr to `<projectDir>/.mxcli/runtime.log` via `io.MultiWriter(log, file)` (the in-memory buffer still backs startup-error reporting). Append across restarts with a `=== runtime start … ===` marker; close the handle on Stop/reopen. Default on; `--runtime-log <path>` relocates, `-` disables. Print the path at boot. Test `TestOpenRuntimeLog`. Findings #25
